acceptedAnswer.text: For most founders the best fit is a fractional senior operator rather than a traditional agency, because the person who builds the relationships and pitches the editors is the person you hired, not a junior account team. Shilika Jain runs Web3 PR directly for $5K–$12K/month and has placed 50+ founders across Forbes, CoinDesk, Cointelegraph, Decrypt, The Block and Blockworks.

mainEntity.name: How much does a Web3 PR agency cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Traditional Web3 agencies commonly charge $15K–$45K per month because the retainer funds a multi-person account team. A fractional senior operator runs the same senior scope for $5K–$12K per month, and a single launch sprint runs $15K–$40K over four to eight weeks.

mainEntity.name: What outlets can you actually get my project into?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tier-1 crypto: CoinDesk, Cointelegraph, The Block, Decrypt, Blockworks, The Defiant. Mainstream where the angle warrants it: Forbes, Bloomberg, Yahoo Finance, Benzinga. Regional: BloomingBit and TokenPost (Korea), CryptoTimes JP and CoinPost (Japan), ChainCatcher and Jinse (China), Inc42 (India), e27 (SEA). Coverage depends on a real news hook, not a wire blast.

mainEntity.name: Do you work with early or pre-token projects?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The highest-leverage work happens six to twelve weeks before a public moment such as a mainnet, raise, listing or TGE. That window is when positioning, journalist relationships and embargo prep can actually be built.

mainEntity.name: How do I get started with Shilika Jain?

acceptedAnswer.text: Send a short project brief through the intent form and you will get a reply within 24 hours with a quick read on your press footprint, or book a 30-minute call to plot it live.
